message.content: {"note_claim": "The bystander who disarmed the gunman in the Bondi Beach shooting is Ahmed al Ahmed.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Ahmed al Ahmed, the hero bystander who tackled and disarmed one of the Bondi shooters on Sunday, has said that despite the immense pain he is in, he does not regret lunging at the gunman.", "reason": "The SMH article directly identifies the hero bystander as Ahmed al Ahmed, confirming the note's central claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The bystander who disarmed the gunman in the Bondi Beach shooting is Ahmed al Ahmed.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Ahmed al Ahmed, the hero bystander who tackled and disarmed one of the Bondi shooters on Sunday, has said that despite the immense pain he is in, he does not regret lunging at the gunman.
parsed.reason: The SMH article directly identifies the hero bystander as Ahmed al Ahmed, confirming the note's central claim.
